rules.statement: A mortgagee must comply with the requirements of sections 643 and 644 of the Civil Procedure Code to bind a puisne incumbrancer, and failure to do so means the puisne incumbrancer is not bound by the mortgage decree.
rules.supporting_quote: "It now appears that the respondent is not in a position to furnish this proof, and we have, therefore, to consider whether, in that state of the facts, the learned District Judge, in declaring the appellant entitled to the 24 lachams in question under the dowry deed, was right in making that declaration of title subject to the mortgage in favour of the respondent. In my opinion he was not."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: sections 643 and 644 of the Civil Procedure Code
